name: Solitaire
description: Klondike solitaire on true black: click or drag cards, double-click to send one to a foundation, draw 1 or 3, unlimited undo, numbered deals, auto-complete and win stats. Your game survives restarts.
author: Yacine-DH

draw.label: Cards drawn from the stock
draw.hint: Applies to the next new game (or right away if you haven't moved yet).

autoComplete.label: Auto-complete when all cards are face up
autoComplete.hint: Plays the remaining cards to the foundations. Off shows a Finish button instead.
